title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fae trickster and planeswalker who leads the heist, is betrayed by Vraska and Jace, and escapes by planeswalking while turning to stone.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Oko's half-fae son who defeats Akul with mind control, rescues Annie, and later invites Amalia to Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A sharpshooter and seer of illusions who spares Kellan by deliberately missing Oko, and is put to sleep by Jace.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who betrays Oko, petrifying him, to secure the child from the vault, saying she must fix what she has done.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker whose scarred, plugged body is revealed beneath the illusion of Ashiok, who takes the child from the vault.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A nightmare-weaving figure who hired Oko's crew; revealed to be an illusion worn by Jace Beleren.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins Kellan against Oko and urges Vraska to return to Ravnica.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: The dragon leader of the Hellspurs, mind-controlled by Kellan and sealed in the collapsing vault.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A giant demon who fights Akul and carries the crew away.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A skeleton thief who crosses the light grid to help open the vault.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin explosives expert who leaves with Malcolm.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A winged siren scout who leaves with Breeches when Vraska does not return.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: A thief on the crew who disarms the vault trap and plans to triple his fee next time.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A warlock who breaks the vault door's ward.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A necromancer and medic.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer and Geralf's sister.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch who stays to ask Oko about Kellan and toasts a future reunion.

entities.name: Amalia
entities.description: A pointed-eared woman with a parasol and mapping satchel who arrives from Ravnica to join Kellan.

entities.name: The vault child
entities.description: An infant with orange fur and horns, held in a glass pod in Maag Taranau, taken by Jace.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Akul's gang who attack the crew inside the vault.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: The company that raided Tarnation.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: A floating vault above Tarnation with traps, a warded door and a treasure chamber containing a child; it flies into the clouds after being opened.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The Hellspur city damaged by the vault's fall.

entities.name: The Wildcard Saloon
entities.description: The crew's hideout, where they regroup.

entities.name: Annie's ranch
entities.description: The ranch where Kellan helps with chores.

entities.name: Orrinshire
entities.description: A sheep-filled town Kellan fondly remembers.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Ral and Amalia are from, offering work for Kellan.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane where Umezawa saw a similar security system.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which Oko returns.

entities.name: The medallion
entities.description: The six-piece key that opens the vault door.

events.summary: Oko's reunited crew enters Maag Taranau, with the silent Annie leading them through traps.
events.quote: Annie's left iris glowed a vivid orange as she approached the outer entrance.

events.summary: Umezawa explains the dual-lever trap, and Tinybones is guided across the light grid with a dragonfly device.
events.quote: Annie did a few practice turns in the air before sending the dragonfly to the edge of the platform.

events.summary: Tinybones and Umezawa pull the levers together and disarm the light grid.
events.quote: They pulled the levers in unison.

events.summary: Kaervek works on breaking the door's ward.
events.quote: Orange flames wove around his fingers, prodding and testing the protection spell.

events.summary: Akul and the Hellspurs arrive, and Rakdos tackles him.
events.quote: Rakdos smashed into his side and clobbered him to the ground.

events.summary: The crew fights the Hellspurs while Kaervek works, and Vraska suggests she and Oko must reach the treasure at any cost.
events.quote: "You and I need to reach the vault's treasure room. No matter the cost."

events.summary: The ward breaks and Oko and Vraska descend, leaving the crew behind.
events.quote: He turned for the door without remorse, disappearing down the stairs with Vraska close behind.

events.summary: Kellan ropes Oko with a golden vine and Ral Zarek appears, confronting Vraska.
events.quote: A golden vine shot toward Oko's wrist, wrapping itself around his hand like a lasso.

events.summary: Vraska tells Ral the only way to fix what she has done is getting what is inside the vault.
events.quote: "The only way to fix what I've done is by getting what's inside the vault."

events.summary: Kellan tells Oko he is his son, not crew, and Oko slams him to the ground with thorned vines after a race for the medallion.
events.quote: Oko barely flicked a finger, and the vines slammed Kellan against the ground with brute force.

events.summary: Annie shoots Oko, purposely missing, and Kellan uses his fae magic as Ashiok's nightmares overwhelm them.
events.quote: Shadows moved across the floor, wrapping around not only Kellan but Annie and Ral, too.

events.summary: Oko uses the key to open the vault door and enters the treasure vault.
events.quote: With the back of his hand, Oko wiped the blood from his chin, and stepped into the treasure vault.

events.summary: Ashiok's illusion drops, revealing Jace Beleren, who puts Annie to sleep.
events.quote: The darkness evaporated, and beneath Ashiok's hooded cloak was Jace Beleren.

events.summary: Jace shatters the pod and takes the sleeping infant from the vault.
events.quote: Jace scooped up the child in his arms, cradling it to his chest.

events.summary: Vraska petrifies Oko, who planeswalks away before the stone reaches his head.
events.quote: "Your services are no longer required,"

events.summary: Kellan wakes to find Vraska, Jace and the child gone and the vault collapsing, and rescues Annie.
events.quote: By the time he reached her side, Vraska, the man, and the child had vanished without a trace.

events.summary: The crew flees the collapsing vault on Rakdos's back.
events.quote: The team fled back through the corridor as the sound of the vault being ripped apart roared behind them.

events.summary: Akul seizes Annie, but Kellan takes control of the dragon's mind and orders him back into the collapsing vault.
events.quote: "Go back inside the vault—and don't come out."

events.summary: Rocks seal Akul inside, and the vault shoots into the clouds and vanishes.
events.quote: the vault shot toward the clouds and vanished from sight.

events.summary: Oko returns to the Wildcard Saloon and tells the crew that Vraska and Ashiok betrayed them.
events.quote: "Vraska and Ashiok were always planning to double-cross us.

events.summary: Oko disbands the crew with the promise of a future reunion, deciding to leave Kellan and Annie alone.
events.quote: "No. From now on, their business is their own,"

events.summary: Weeks later, Kellan works on Annie's ranch and Ral offers him a job on Ravnica, which he declines.
events.quote: "I think I've done enough wandering for a while,"

events.summary: Amalia arrives from Ravnica in answer to Kellan's invitation, and they embrace.
events.quote: "I missed you, Kellan,"

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's father; Kellan says he is son, not crew.
relations.quote: "I'm not your crew; I'm your son."
Your services are no longer required,

relations.note: Ashiok was an illusion worn by Jace.
relations.quote: beneath Ashiok's hooded cloak was Jace Beleren.

relations.note: They work together to take the child from the vault.
relations.quote: Vraska and Ashiok had tricked him. Or Vraska and Jace , it seemed.

relations.note: Ral says they are friends and urges her to return to Ravnica.
Ral and Kellan work together against Oko and Ral offers him a job.
relations.quote: I could really use someone I trust.

relations.note: Annie protects Kellan and he stays at her ranch.
Kellan mind-controls Akul and seals him in the vault.
relations.quote: It wasn't just hypnosis—it was control .

relations.note: Kellan blushes about expecting Amalia, and she says she missed him.

relations.quote: "I knew there was a reason I liked you."

relations.note: Gisa and Geralf are siblings who continue bickering.
relations.quote: I guess you can count me and my brother in.
